data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: ref-query.sh detects bm25s availability via guarded import and uses it for ranking when importable ← sc-3
- dd-2: With bm25s NOT importable: falls back to stdlib BM25, writes single-line stderr notice prefixed [ref-query], stdout unchanged, exit 0 ← sc-3
- dd-4: Both code paths return results within 10s on seed corpus ← sc-3

## Implementation
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py following the established codebase pattern (see classify-task.py:13-21, semantic-conflict-check.py:31-34):

1. At module top (after stdlib imports):
   try:
       import bm25s
       _BM25S_AVAILABLE = True
   except ImportError:
       _BM25S_AVAILABLE = False
   _NOTICE_EMITTED = False

2. In the ranking function, branch on _BM25S_AVAILABLE:
   - True: use bm25s for ranking
   - False: use stdlib BM25 AND if not _NOTICE_EMITTED: write single line to stderr starting with [ref-query] (e.g., "[ref-query] bm25s not available; using stdlib BM25 fallback"), set _NOTICE_EMITTED = True

3. Preserve stdout shape exactly between paths; exit 0 on success in both cases
4. Both paths complete within 10s on seed corpus

Constraints: do NOT add bm25s to pyproject.toml; do NOT alter the public CLI signature.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] ref-query.py contains guarded bm25s import and _BM25S_AVAILABLE sentinel
  Verify: grep -q 'import bm25s' plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py && grep -q '_BM25S_AVAILABLE' plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py
- [ ] ref-query.py contains _NOTICE_EMITTED latch
  Verify: grep -q '_NOTICE_EMITTED' plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py
- [ ] Fallback notice uses [ref-query] prefix
  Verify: grep -q '\[ref-query\]' plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py
- [ ] All 3 task-1 tests pass (GREEN)
  Verify: pytest tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py::test_ref_query_uses_bm25s_when_importable tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py::test_ref_query_falls_back_when_bm25s_missing tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py::test_ref_query_notice_emitted_once_per_process
- [ ] bm25s NOT in pyproject.toml
  Verify: ! grep -q 'bm25s' pyproject.toml
- [ ] All pre-existing test_ref_query.py tests pass (no regression)
  Verify: pytest tests/scripts/test_ref_query.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
